descriptionByLocale.en:
Assistant Store Manager (Yorkdale Shopping Centre) - Swatch Group Assistant Store Manager (Yorkdale Shopping Centre) The company Swatch embraces the values that coexist in the worlds of art, design, fashion and technology; and lends to them its own spark of creativity. Thus, Swatch is considered a canvas upon which a myriad of expressions have been applied. Cutting edge style, trend setting looks and technology friendly accents have all added to the amazement of owning a Swatch. 
• Job description The Assistant Store Manager, reporting to the Store Manager, plays a key role in managing all aspects of the store's operations. This role involves driving sales through motivation and support of the staff, guiding the sales team to provide exceptional customer service for sales growth, and meeting operational objectives and ensuring adherence to company policies and procedures. Assistant Store Manager has to possess the following Swatch Core Competencies: Customer Focus, Drive for Results, Creativity, Problem-Solving, Humility, Integrity, Building Effective Teams and Relationships. Starting base pay of $45,000.00 plus monthly performance bonus. Benefits: Paid Vacations Paid sick days Health benefits, including dental and vision coverage. Life insurance RRSP contributions with company match Company Discount 
• Responsibilities include: Customer Service & Sales Generation: Coaching the sales team to enhance customer experiences and achieve sales targets, ensuring product knowledge, and monitoring performance. Operations: Assisting in managing store efficiency, adhering to procedures, inventory control, and addressing inventory discrepancies. Personnel Management: Supporting recruitment, development, and disciplinary processes, contributing to staff evaluations and development plans. Visual Merchandising: Helping maintain store presentation standards. Other: Upholding workplace safety, serving as a role model for company policies and procedures. Working Conditions: Work is performed with moderate physical effort is required and significant walking and standing is required for the majority of each shift. While this position has a low risk of injury, the position requires lifting, pushing, pulling and holding (up to 35 lbs and above with appropriate support) of boxes and store fixtures, as well as, significant focus when completing paperwork, cash management or using the POS. Employment Status: Full-Time: 40 hours per week on average. Must maintain open availability to meet the needs of the business and may be required to work more than 40 hours per week, including certain holidays and blackout dates. 
• Profile Strong communication skills (verbal & written), including strong relationship building skills. Availability to work opening and closing shifts; flexible hours including weekends and holidays. Effective leadership skills to mentor and motivate retail team. Results oriented with a high level of energy and enthusiasm. Ability to communicate in a clear concise and understandable manner. Must be a self-starter who works well independently and in team environments. Professional requirements At least 3 years retail leadership experience, preferably in fashion and/or accessories. Intermediate computer skills with working knowledge of MS Office. Experience working with POS systems. Job location Dufferin Street 3401 M6A 2T9 North York ON MA T (Ontario) Canada Company address The Swatch Group (Canada) Ltd. 555, Richmond Street West Suite 1105 CA-Toronto M5V 3B1, Ontario Apply for this job Share this job offer

Assistant Store Manager (Yorkdale Shopping Centre)
The company
Swatch embraces the values that coexist in the worlds of art, design, fashion and technology; and lends to them its own spark of creativity. Thus, Swatch is considered a canvas upon which a myriad of expressions have been applied. Cutting edge style, trend setting looks and technology friendly accents have all added to the amazement of owning a Swatch.
Job description
The Assistant Store Manager, reporting to the Store Manager, plays a key role in managing all aspects of the store's operations. This role involves driving sales through motivation and support of the staff, guiding the sales team to provide exceptional customer service for sales growth, and meeting operational objectives and ensuring adherence to company policies and procedures. Assistant Store Manager has to possess the following Swatch Core Competencies: Customer Focus, Drive for Results, Creativity, Problem-Solving, Humility, Integrity, Building Effective Teams and Relationships.
• Starting base pay of $45,000.00 plus monthly performance bonus.
• Benefits:
• Paid Vacations
• Paid sick days
• Health benefits, including dental and vision coverage.
• Life insurance
• RRSP contributions with company match
• Company Discount
• Responsibilities include:
• Customer Service & Sales Generation: Coaching the sales team to enhance customer experiences and achieve sales targets, ensuring product knowledge, and monitoring performance.
• Operations: Assisting in managing store efficiency, adhering to procedures, inventory control, and addressing inventory discrepancies.
• Personnel Management: Supporting recruitment, development, and disciplinary processes, contributing to staff evaluations and development plans.
• Visual Merchandising: Helping maintain store presentation standards.
• Other: Upholding workplace safety, serving as a role model for company policies and procedures.
• Working Conditions:
Work is performed with moderate physical effort is required and significant walking and standing is required for the majority of each shift. While this position has a low risk of injury, the position requires lifting, pushing, pulling and holding (up to 35 lbs and above with appropriate support) of boxes and store fixtures, as well as, significant focus when completing paperwork, cash management or using the POS.
Employment Status:
Full-Time: 40 hours per week on average. Must maintain open availability to meet the needs of the business and may be required to work more than 40 hours per week, including certain holidays and blackout dates.
Profile
• Strong communication skills (verbal & written), including strong relationship building skills.
• Availability to work opening and closing shifts; flexible hours including weekends and holidays.
• Effective leadership skills to mentor and motivate retail team.
• Results oriented with a high level of energy and enthusiasm.
• Ability to communicate in a clear concise and understandable manner.
• Must be a self-starter who works well independently and in team environments.
• Professional requirements
• At least 3 years retail leadership experience, preferably in fashion and/or accessories.
• Intermediate computer skills with working knowledge of MS Office.
• Experience working with POS systems.

# Sales Representative - Omega Boutique Zurich (M/W) - Swatch Group

## Company Description
Omega is a prestigious global brand that has been striving for the highest quality, ultimate precision, and continuous innovation for over 170 years. Our watches are among the best in the world, the result of technologies that are leading in the watchmaking industry and characterized by timeless design.

Throughout our long history, we have set precision records, significantly influenced sports timing, and continue to take a pioneering role in high-end watchmaking.

As an international brand, we are always interested in getting to know future colleagues who are ready to support our teams on almost every continent with their talents, ambitions, and inspiration.

## Job Description
- Contribute actively to the success of the boutique and the achievement of sales targets
- Generate and maintain contact with our demanding customer base
- Be an ambassador for our brand and provide high-level customer advice, including all technical details of our watches

## Profile
- Similar experience in the luxury segment, ideally in the watch and jewelry industry
- Outgoing sales personality with initiative
- High-level service orientation for our demanding customer base

## Professional Requirements
- Well-groomed, courteous, and impeccable appearance
- Excellent team spirit, available and flexible
- Language skills
  - Very good knowledge of German or French and English (additional languages are an advantage)

## Contact Person
Jean-Baptiste Haas
HR Business Partner

## Work Location
Bahnhofstrasse 48
8001 Zurich (Zurich)
Switzerland

## Company Address
Omega AG
Jakob-Stämpfli-Strasse 96
CH-2502 Biel

Omega è un prestigioso marchio globale che da oltre 170 anni si impegna per la massima qualità, massima precisione e continua innovazione. - Personalità delle vendite in uscita con iniziativa

Désignation de l'entreprise
Omega est une marque mondiale prestigieuse qui recherche la plus haute qualité, la précision ultime et l'innovation continue depuis plus de 170 ans. Nos montres sont parmi les meilleures au monde, le résultat de technologies qui sont leader dans l'industrie horlogère et caractérisées par un design intemporel.

The company
Hinter jeder sportlichen Leistung stehen Jahre des Trainings und der Selbstüberwindung. Hinter jedem Ergebnis steht Wissen, Erfahrung, Hochtechnologie und die Präzision von Swiss Timing. Als Tochterunternehmen von Swiss Timing realisiert die ST Sportservice GmbH seit mehr als 25 Jahren den Service bei internationalen Sportgroßveranstaltungen. Wir agieren auf höchstem Niveau in einem einzigartigen Umfeld.
Um unsere Lösungen weiter zu entwickeln, suchen wir ständig leistungsbereite, motivierte, innovative Mitarbeiter. Als Partner des Internationalen Olympischen Komitees werden wir den Zeitnahme-, TV-Grafik- und Datenservice bei den Olympischen Sommer- und Winterspielen bis ins Jahr 2032 und darüber hinaus realisieren. Dazu brauchen wir Dich!
Job description
Als Elektroniker der Fachrichtung Geräte und Systeme bei ST SPORTSERVICE fertigst, montierst, prüfst, testest und reparierst Du Komponenten und elektronische Sportmessgeräte die bei internationalen Sportevents eingesetzt werden. Du arbeitest mit unterschiedlichsten Werkzeugen, kleinen Bauteilen und Schaltplänen oder nutzt Mess- und Prüfgeräte um zu erkennen, ob die von Dir gefertigten Komponenten und Geräte fehlerfrei funktionieren. Ein besonderes Highlight Deiner Ausbildung sind Deine Einsätze als Techniker bei internationalen Sportevents, wie z.B. Weltcups, Weltmeisterschaften oder Olympische Spiele, in den großen Stadien und Arenen der Welt.
Deine 
• Aufgaben:
Bereitstellung von Geräten und technischen Komponenten
Pflege, Wartung und Reparatur des Equipments
Vorbereitung des Equipments incl. Fertigung, Installation, Konfiguration und Systemtest
Auf-und Abbau, Bedienung und technischer Support bei internationalen Sportevents vor Ort
Nutzerunterstützung und Einweisungen
Profile
Du bist sind ein Teamplayer und verfügst über eine gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit? Du arbeitest gern an verantwortungsvollen

selbständiges Arbeiten in einem tollen Team
eine praxisnahe und abwechslungsreiche Ausbildung mit Reisen zu internationalen Sportveranstaltungen
attraktive Sozialleistungen und faire Ausbildungsvergütung
berufliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem sehr dynamischen und internationalen Arbeitsumfeld

Angestrebte oder abgeschlossene Fachhochschulreife Technik oder Hochschulreife

Gerne unterwegs, auch am Wochenende

descriptionByLocale.en:
Retail Sales Advisor Tissot - Swatch Group Retail Sales Advisor Tissot The company Tissot, watchmakers blending tradition and pioneering spirit since 1853, nestled in the Swiss mountains of Le Locle. Tissot crafts watches that become the storytellers of life's voyage: it's not just the destination that matters, but the importance of the path filled with significant milestones and unforgettable memories. The brand’s ambassadors, including American basketball star Damian Lillard, Italian motorcycling sensation Enea Bastianini, Slovenian cyclist Primož Roglič, and Chinese Actors Liu Yifei and Simon Gong exemplify the hours of dedication preceding one’s excellence. On a broader stage, Tissot also partners with the NBA, MotoGPTM, and the Tour de France as their Official Timekeeper. Discover Tissot’s collections: T-Touch, PRX, Chemin des Tourelles. Every Swiss timepiece crafted embodies a fusion of heritage and innovation, and while priced accessibly, stands as an enduring legacy defying the constraints of time. Going beyond watchmaking and timekeeping, Tissot accompanies individuals in every moment, celebrating not only the achievements, but the journey itself. 
• Job description Sales Greet and serve all customers providing a friendly service and delivering a full and memorable experience. Ensure familiarity with the product range, past and present, so that customers can be provided with as much detail as necessary. Ensure good knowledge of all functions of watches and other Tissot products. Provide reliable information to customers in all matters relating to sales and customer service. Help display merchandise as directed. Contribute to the store reaching its monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets. Deliver exceptional customer service to every customer, every time. Whether by email, over the phone, or in person in the Boutique. Security Assist in controlling shrinkage by attentive action on the shop floor, merchandise handling, accident prevention and careful operation of the till and administration policies and procedures. Maintain/build a general awareness of products and security hot spots. Follow Company policy and procedures for opening/closing the store. Maintain correct processing of all deliveries. Cash Handling/Payment Transactions All transactions to be handled in a responsible and secure way. Till functions, cashing up, payments and general duties. Dealing with, and handling of, cash, credits cards and international currency. Care of the Store Ensure the store is kept clean and presentable at all times. Back of house and shop floor are both just as important. Health and Safety aware. Good Visual Merchandising standards. Communication Adhere to company policies and regulations. Attend briefing sessions as directed by your line manager. Can present, and conduct, themselves in a professional manner to both customers and colleagues. Can deal with international customers and familiar with their customs and culture. Can communicate clearly to consumers and colleagues. Product Knowledge Attend regular training days. Take responsibility, and be self-motivated and pro-active, to understand all new products and apply training and instructions. Be able to deliver good product knowledge to our customers. 
• Profile Essential Experience in the Retail Industry at a sales advisor level. Preferably from a watch/jewellery, or prestige retail background. Must have an understanding of luxury retail. Must enjoy their work and have a natural passion for Tissot, watches in general, or selling in a luxury retailer. Preferred Be accommodating to shifts, longer trading hours and staying late for VIP’s etc. Have experience dealing with international customers. Ability to communicate in other languages for example, Mandarin or Arabic. Job location 7 James Street WC2E 8BH ECV London (England) United Kingdom Company address The Swatch Group (UK) Limited 77 Marsh Wall 12th Floor London E14 9SH Apply for this job Share this job offer

The company
Tissot, watchmakers blending tradition and pioneering spirit since 1853, nestled in the Swiss mountains of Le Locle. Discover Tissot’s collections: T-Touch, PRX, Chemin des Tourelles. Every Swiss timepiece crafted embodies a fusion of heritage and innovation, and while priced accessibly, stands as an enduring legacy defying the constraints of time. Going beyond watchmaking and timekeeping, Tissot accompanies individuals in every moment, celebrating not only the achievements, but the journey itself.
Job description
• Sales
• Greet and serve all customers providing a friendly service and delivering a full and memorable experience.
• Ensure familiarity with the product range, past and present, so that customers can be provided with as much detail as necessary.
• Ensure good knowledge of all functions of watches and other Tissot products.
• Provide reliable information to customers in all matters relating to sales and customer service.
• Help display merchandise as directed.
• Contribute to the store reaching its monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.
• Deliver exceptional customer service to every customer, every time. Whether by email, over the phone, or in person in the Boutique.
• Security
• Assist in controlling shrinkage by attentive action on the shop floor, merchandise handling, accident prevention and careful operation of the till and administration policies and procedures.
• Maintain/build a general awareness of products and security hot spots.
• Follow Company policy and procedures for opening/closing the store.
• Maintain correct processing of all deliveries.
• Cash Handling/Payment Transactions
• All transactions to be handled in a responsible and secure way.
• Till functions, cashing up, payments and general duties.
• Dealing with, and handling of, cash, credits cards and international currency.
• Care of the Store
• Ensure the store is kept clean and presentable at all times.
• Back of house and shop floor are both just as important.
• Health and Safety aware.
• Good Visual Merchandising standards.
• Communication
• Adhere to company policies and regulations.
• Attend briefing sessions as directed by your line manager.
• Can present, and conduct, themselves in a professional manner to both customers and colleagues.
• Can deal with international customers and familiar with their customs and culture.
• Can communicate clearly to consumers and colleagues.
• Product Knowledge
• Attend regular training days.
• Take responsibility, and be self-motivated and pro-active, to understand all new products and apply training and instructions.
• Be able to deliver good product knowledge to our customers.
• Profile
• Essential
• Experience in the Retail Industry at a sales advisor level.
• Preferably from a watch/jewellery, or prestige retail background.
• Must have an understanding of luxury retail.
• Must enjoy their work and have a natural passion for Tissot, watches in general, or selling in a luxury retailer.
• Preferred
• Be accommodating to shifts, longer trading hours and staying late for VIP’s etc.
• Have experience dealing with international customers.
• Ability to communicate in other languages for example, Mandarin or Arabic.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Retail Sales Advisor Tissot - Swatch Group

Retail Sales Advisor Tissot
The company
Tissot, watchmakers blending tradition and pioneering spirit since 1853, nestled in the Swiss mountains of Le Locle. Tissot crafts watches that become the storytellers of life's voyage: it's not just the destination that matters, but the importance of the path filled with significant milestones and unforgettable memories. The brand’s ambassadors, including American basketball star Damian Lillard, Italian motorcycling sensation Enea Bastianini, Slovenian cyclist Primož Roglič, and Chinese Actors Liu Yifei and Simon Gong exemplify the hours of dedication preceding one’s excellence. On a broader stage, Tissot also partners with the NBA, MotoGPTM, and the Tour de France as their Official Timekeeper.
Discover Tissot’s collections: T-Touch, PRX, Chemin des Tourelles. Every Swiss timepiece crafted embodies a fusion of heritage and innovation, and while priced accessibly, stands as an enduring legacy defying the constraints of time. Going beyond watchmaking and timekeeping, Tissot accompanies individuals in every moment, celebrating not only the achievements, but the journey itself.
Job description
• Sales
• Greet and serve all customers providing a friendly service and delivering a full and memorable experience.
• Ensure familiarity with the product range, past and present, so that customers can be provided with as much detail as necessary.
• Ensure good knowledge of all functions of watches and other Tissot products.
• Provide reliable information to customers in all matters relating to sales and customer service.
• Help display merchandise as directed.
• Contribute to the store reaching its monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.
• Deliver exceptional customer service to every customer, every time. Whether by email, over the phone, or in person in the Boutique.
• Security
• Assist in controlling shrinkage by attentive action on the shop floor, merchandise handling, accident prevention and careful operation of the till and administration policies and procedures.
• Maintain/build a general awareness of products and security hot spots.
• Follow Company policy and procedures for opening/closing the store.
• Maintain correct processing of all deliveries.
• Cash Handling/Payment Transactions
• All transactions to be handled in a responsible and secure way.
• Till functions, cashing up, payments and general duties.
• Dealing with, and handling of, cash, credits cards and international currency.
• Care of the Store
• Ensure the store is kept clean and presentable at all times.
• Back of house and shop floor are both just as important.
• Health and Safety aware.
• Good Visual Merchandising standards.
• Communication
• Adhere to company policies and regulations.
• Attend briefing sessions as directed by your line manager.
• Can present, and conduct, themselves in a professional manner to both customers and colleagues.
• Can deal with international customers and familiar with their customs and culture.
• Can communicate clearly to consumers and colleagues.
• Product Knowledge
• Attend regular training days.
• Take responsibility, and be self-motivated and pro-active, to understand all new products and apply training and instructions.
• Be able to deliver good product knowledge to our customers.
• Profile
• Essential
• Experience in the Retail Industry at a sales advisor level.
• Preferably from a watch/jewellery, or prestige retail background.
• Must have an understanding of luxury retail.
• Must enjoy their work and have a natural passion for Tissot, watches in general, or selling in a luxury retailer.
• Preferred
• Be accommodating to shifts, longer trading hours and staying late for VIP’s etc.
• Have experience dealing with international customers.
• Ability to communicate in other languages for example, Mandarin or Arabic.

Contribuirai al raggiungimento degli obiettivi aziendali, gestendo le relazioni con la clientela e occupandoti di assistenza alla vendita e post vendita. Conosci i principali strumenti informatici ed hai un’elevata predisposizione all’uso della tecnologia. Per qualcuno l’orologio misura “solo” il tempo, per noi scandisce in ogni minuto la nostra vera passione! Unisciti a NOI! Vieni a far parte del nostro Team! descriptionByLocale.en:
Visual Merchandiser & Trainer - Northeast - Swatch Group

Visual Merchandiser & Trainer - Northeast
The Company
Hamilton has been an iconic name in precision watchmaking since its founding in Lancaster, Pennsylvania in 1892. Its watches have synchronized the first railroads and furnished the wrists of soldiers, aviators and Hollywood stars, making over 500 appearances on the big screen. Hamilton has been at the forefront of innovations in design, technology and craft by launching the world’s first electric timepiece in 1957 and LED digital watch in 1970. A member of the Swatch Group, the global leader in watch manufacturing and distribution, Hamilton combines its American spirit with true Swiss precision.
Job description
As a Visual Merchandiser & Trainer with Hamilton, U.S., the position will be responsible to support the watch sales within our retail and wholesale account through visual merchandising and training. This role will oversee the visual representation of our Hamilton brand and products in all boutiques (retail and wholesale) within assigned Northeast Territory region. Visual Merchandiser & Trainer will also be responsible for maintaining training initiatives that will increase Hamilton brand and product knowledge. Tasks include the planning, organization, coordination, training and implementation of all Visual Merchandising measures that have been developed by brand.
This position is a field position.
Profile
Visual Merchandising Responsibilities
• Implement and maintain visual merchandising standards across retail and wholesale store locations, ensuring compliance with Company guidelines and brand standards.
• Conduct regular store visits to evaluate visual execution, providing on-the-spot adjustments and recommendations.
• Contribute to achieving sales volume goals by ensuring effective presentations and maintenance of all product
categories, making sure that all stores are set up correctly during promotions and regular business.
• Prepare and distribute communication materials related to visual displays in accordance with brand guidelines.
• Manage vendor relationships by placing and following up on visual orders to ensure timely implementation and centralized mailing of visual materials to trade location.
• Coordinate internal distribution of visual materials to stores, ensuring compliance and visibility.
• Collaborate with retail locations, regional teams, and brand leadership to plan and execute floor sets, window displays, seasonal transitions, and promotional setups.
• Identify visual merchandising opportunities within and outside stores, developing innovative window decoration ideas.
• Create and maintain a photo library documenting boutique conditions before and after visits.
• Provide recap reports summarizing store visit findings and improvement recommendations.
• Assist Visual Manager and SIS Project Manager with identifying SIS opportunities and maintenance/renovation needs.
• Lead first-class setup and decoration of brand-sponsored events, mono- and multi-brand related, to maximize visual impact.
• Partner with management in planning and executing functional training, leadership development, product and sales training and other agreed training strategies.
Training & Development Responsibilities
• Facilitate training sessions for store managers and associates focused on current visual merchandising standards, product placement, and customer experience best practices.
• Provide comprehensive communication and training programs to stores
• Partner with management on planning and executing functional, leadership, product, and sales training programs.
• Provide ongoing coaching to store teams, identifying skill gaps and recommending development initiatives.
• Foster strong relationships with store teams to support adoption of visual and training standards.
Additional Responsibilities
• Monitor regional business trends, competitor trends by reading and understanding business reports and identify potential opportunities to support sales growth.
• Perform other duties as assigned by management.
Requirements
Education and Experience Requirements
• High School Diploma or GED required; College degree preferred.
• 2-3 years of retail visual merchandising experience, preferably in specialty goods, jewelry, or watches.
• Strong verbal and written communication skills.
• Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
• Valid driver’s license required.
• Proven ability to coach and train diverse teams in a fast-paced retail environment.
• Strong eye for design, layout, and brand storytelling through product presentation.
• Ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities and thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
• The work schedule will vary from Monday through Friday and may include an occasional weekend.
• Ability to domestically and internationally up to 80-85% of the time (minimum 4 days per workweek).
Physical Requirements:
This is primarily active position which requires the Visual Merchandiser & Trainer to move about the various locations while continuously climbing ladders, bending, stooping, lifting, reaching, moving and carrying up to 40 lbs. There is frequent travel to multiple retail locations within assigned territory. The position requires the ability to operate motor vehicles, computers and tablets, communicate clearly, and engage physically with visual merchandising setups. Finger dexterity is necessary. Occasional evening or weekend work to support store openings, seasonal transitions, or special events.
Additional Skill Requirements:
• Strong organizational, project management, and problem-solving skills.
• Confident communicator and presenter.
• Self-motivated, proactive, and a quick learner.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Ability to remain engaged and responsive when working remotely.
• Flexibility to work extended hours when required.
• Willingness to accept feedback and continuously improve.
This description outlines the basic responsibilities and requirements for the role. This is not a comprehensive listing of all job duties of the Visual Merchandiser & Trainer. Duties, responsibilities and activities may evolve or change at any time
with or without notice.
Compensation & Benefits
The annual base salary range for this position is $70,000–$77,000. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience and skills. This position is also eligible for an annual bonus.
The Swatch Group is an equal opportunity employer that promotes diversity and is committed to environmental sustainability.
Excellent health, dental and vision insurance (employee and dependents are eligible 1st of the month following 30 days; generous employer contribution)
Immediate participation in the 401(k) and 100% vested employer match after one year (maximum 4% employer match with 5% employee contribution)
Company paid life insurance and Long Term Disability
18 days of PTO per year
Special bucket of sick time per year extended paid time for medical, parental and military leave
Holiday pay
Voluntary FSA, STD, Accident/Hospital Indemnity insurance
Employee product discount

descriptionByLocale.it: Visual Merchandiser & Trainer - Northeast - Swatch Group Visual Merchandiser & Trainer - Northeast L'Azienda Hamilton è un nome iconico in orologeria di precisione sin dalla sua fondazione a Lancaster, Pennsylvania nel 1892. I suoi orologi hanno sincronizzato le prime ferrovie e arredato i polsi di soldati, aviatori e stelle di Hollywood, facendo oltre 500 apparizioni sul grande schermo. Hamilton è stato all’avanguardia nelle innovazioni nel design, nella tecnologia e nell’artigianato lanciando il primo orologio elettrico al mondo nel 1957 e l’orologio digitale a LED nel 1970. Membro del Gruppo Swatch, leader mondiale nella produzione e distribuzione di orologi, Hamilton combina il suo spirito americano con la vera precisione svizzera. Descrizione del lavoro Come Visual Merchandiser & Trainer con Hamilton, Stati Uniti, la posizione sarà responsabile di supportare le vendite di orologi all'interno del nostro conto retail e all'ingrosso attraverso la merchandising visiva e la formazione. Questo ruolo sovrintenderà alla rappresentazione visiva del nostro marchio Hamilton e dei nostri prodotti in tutte le boutique (particolare e all'ingrosso) all'interno della regione del Territorio Nord-Est assegnato. Visual Merchandiser & Trainer sarà anche responsabile del mantenimento di iniziative di formazione che aumenteranno il marchio Hamilton e la conoscenza del prodotto. Compiti includono la pianificazione, l'organizzazione, il coordinamento, la formazione e l'attuazione di tutte le misure di Visual Merchandising che sono state sviluppate dal marchio. Questa posizione è una posizione sul campo. Responsabilità di visualizzazione del profilo • Implementa e mantieni gli standard di merchandising visivo nelle sedi dei negozi al dettaglio e all'ingrosso, garantendo il rispetto delle linee guida aziendali e degli standard di marca. • Condurre visite di negozio regolari per valutare l'esecuzione visiva, fornendo modifiche e raccomandazioni in loco. • Contribuire al raggiungimento degli obiettivi del volume di vendita garantendo presentazioni e manutenzione efficaci di tutte le categorie di prodotti, assicurandosi che tutti i negozi siano impostati correttamente durante le promozioni e gli affari regolari. • Preparare e distribuire materiali di comunicazione relativi a display visivi secondo le linee guida del marchio. • Gestire i rapporti dei fornitori mettendo e seguendo gli ordini visivi per garantire l'implementazione tempestiva e la postazione centralizzata dei materiali visivi alla posizione commerciale. • Coordinare la distribuzione interna dei materiali visivi ai negozi, garantendo la conformità e la visibilità. • Collaborare con sedi di vendita al dettaglio, team regionali e leadership del marchio per pianificare ed eseguire set di pavimenti, display finestra, transizioni stagionali e configurazioni promozionali. • Identificare opportunità di merchandising visivo all'interno e all'esterno dei negozi, sviluppando idee innovative di decorazione delle finestre. • Creare e mantenere una libreria fotografica che documenta le condizioni di boutique prima e dopo le visite. • Fornire rapporti di riconquista che sintetizzano i risultati della visita del negozio e raccomandazioni di miglioramento. • Assist Visual Manager e SIS Project Manager con l'individuazione delle opportunità e delle esigenze di manutenzione/ristrutturazione SIS. • Configurazione di prima classe e decorazione di eventi sponsorizzati dal marchio, mono e multi-brand correlati, per massimizzare l'impatto visivo. • Partner con la gestione nella pianificazione e nell'esecuzione di formazione funzionale, sviluppo della leadership, formazione dei prodotti e delle vendite e altre strategie di formazione concordate. Responsabilità di formazione e sviluppo • Facilitate sessioni di formazione per i manager dei negozi e gli associati focalizzati sugli attuali standard di merchandising visivo, sul posizionamento dei prodotti e sulle migliori pratiche di customer experience. • Fornire programmi di comunicazione e formazione completi ai negozi • Partner con la gestione della pianificazione e dell'esecuzione di programmi di formazione funzionali, di leadership, di prodotto e di vendita. • Fornire coaching in corso per memorizzare le squadre, identificare le lacune di abilità e consigliare iniziative di sviluppo. • Promuovere relazioni forti con i team di store per sostenere l'adozione di standard visivi e formativi. Responsabilità aggiuntive • Monitorare le tendenze aziendali regionali, le tendenze dei concorrenti attraverso la lettura e la comprensione delle relazioni aziendali e identificare le potenziali opportunità di sostegno alla crescita delle vendite. • Eseguire altri compiti assegnati dalla direzione. Requisiti di istruzione e di esperienza • Diploma di scuola superiore o GED richiesto; diploma universitario preferito. • 2-3 anni di esperienza di merchandising visivo al dettaglio, preferibilmente in beni di specialità, gioielli, o orologi. • Forte capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta. • Proficiente in Microsoft Word, Excel e PowerPoint. • Valida patente di guida richiesta. • Prove capacità di allenare e formare diverse squadre in un ambiente di vendita al dettaglio veloce. • Occhio forte per design, layout e storytelling del marchio attraverso la presentazione del prodotto. • Capacità di dare priorità a molteplici responsabilità e prosperare in un ambiente dinamico e veloce. • Il programma di lavoro varia da lunedì a venerdì e può includere un fine settimana occasionale. • Capacità a livello nazionale e internazionale fino all'80-85% del tempo (minimo 4 giorni per settimana lavorativa). Requisiti fisici: Questa posizione è principalmente attiva che richiede al Visual Merchandiser & Trainer di muoversi sulle varie posizioni, mentre scalate continuamente, piegando, stooping, sollevando, raggiungendo, muovendosi e portando fino a 40 lbs. Ci sono frequenti viaggi in più punti vendita all'interno del territorio assegnato. La posizione richiede la capacità di operare veicoli a motore, computer e tablet, comunicare con chiarezza e interagire fisicamente con le configurazioni di merchandising visivo. La destrezza del cervo è necessaria. Occasionalmente sera o fine settimana di lavoro per sostenere le aperture di negozio, transizioni stagionali, o eventi speciali. Requisiti di abilità aggiuntive: • Forte capacità organizzative, di project management e di problem solving. • comunicatore e presentatore fiducioso. • Automotivato, proattivo, e un apprendimento rapido. • Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e come parte di una squadra. • Capacità di rimanere impegnato e reattivo quando si lavora da remoto. • Flessibilità di lavorare ore estese quando necessario. • Volontà di accettare feedback e migliorare continuamente. Questa descrizione illustra le responsabilità e i requisiti fondamentali per il ruolo. Questo non è un elenco completo di tutti i compiti di lavoro del Visual Merchandiser & Trainer. I compiti, le responsabilità e le attività possono evolversi o cambiare in qualsiasi momento con o senza preavviso. Compensazioni e vantaggi La gamma di stipendio base annuale per questa posizione è di $ 70,000–$77,000. La compensazione effettiva sarà determinata in base a fattori quali l'esperienza e le competenze. Questa posizione è ammissibile anche per un bonus annuale. descriptionByLocale.de: Visual Merchandiser & Trainer - Northeast - Swatch Group Visual Merchandiser & Trainer - Nordost Das Unternehmen Hamilton ist seit seiner Gründung in Lancaster, Pennsylvania im Jahre 1892 ein ikonischer Name in der Präzisionsuhrmacherei. Seine Uhren haben die ersten Eisenbahnen synchronisiert und die Handgelenke von Soldaten, Aviatoren und Hollywood-Stars eingerichtet, wodurch über 500 Auftritte auf dem großen Bildschirm. Hamilton ist an der Spitze der Innovationen in Design, Technologie und Handwerk, indem er das weltweit erste Elektro-Timepiece in 1957 und LED Digital Watch in 1970. Als Mitglied der Swatch Group, der weltweit führende Anbieter von Uhrenherstellung und -verteilung, kombiniert Hamilton seinen amerikanischen Geist mit wahrer Schweizer Präzision. Jobbeschreibung Als Visual Merchandiser & Trainer mit Hamilton, USA, wird die Position verantwortlich sein, den Uhrenverkauf innerhalb unseres Retail- und Großhandelskontos durch visuelles Merchandising und Training zu unterstützen. Diese Rolle wird die visuelle Darstellung unserer Hamilton Marke und Produkte in allen Boutiquen (Einzelhandel und Großhandel) innerhalb der zugewiesenen Region Northeast Territory überwachen. Visual Merchandiser & Trainer wird auch für die Aufrechterhaltung von Trainingsinitiativen verantwortlich sein, die die Marke Hamilton und das Produktwissen erhöhen. Zu den Aufgaben gehören die Planung, Organisation, Koordination, Schulung und Umsetzung aller von der Marke entwickelten Visual Merchandising-Maßnahmen. Diese Position ist eine Feldposition. Profile Visual Merchandising Responsibilities • Ergänzen und pflegen visuelle Merchandising-Standards in Einzelhandels- und Großhandelsgeschäften, um die Einhaltung von Unternehmensrichtlinien und Markenstandards zu gewährleisten. • Durchführung regelmäßiger Speicherbesuche zur Bewertung der visuellen Ausführung, Bereitstellung vor Ort Anpassungen und Empfehlungen. • Beitrag zur Erreichung von Umsatzvolumen-Zielen durch die Gewährleistung effektiver Präsentationen und Wartung aller Produktkategorien, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Geschäfte korrekt während der Promotions und regelmäßigen Geschäfts. • Bereiten und Verteilen von Kommunikationsmaterialien im Zusammenhang mit visuellen Anzeigen gemäß Markenrichtlinien. • Verwalten von Vendor-Beziehungen, indem sie visuelle Bestellungen aufstellen und verfolgen, um eine rechtzeitige Umsetzung und zentralisierte Versand von visuellen Materialien an den Handelsplatz zu gewährleisten. • Koordinierte interne Verteilung von visuellen Materialien in den Läden, Sicherstellung der Einhaltung und Sichtbarkeit. • Zusammenarbeit mit Einzelhandelsstandorten, regionalen Teams und Markenführungen, um Bodensätze, Fensteranzeigen, saisonale Übergänge und Werbe-Setups zu planen und auszuführen. • Erkennen Sie visuelle Merchandising-Möglichkeiten innerhalb und außerhalb von Läden und entwickeln innovative Fensterdekoration Ideen. • Erstellen und pflegen Sie eine Fotobibliothek, die Boutique-Bedingungen vor und nach Besuchen dokumentiert. • Bereitstellung von Recap-Berichten, die die Ergebnisse von Ladenbesuchen und Verbesserungsempfehlungen zusammenfassen. • Assist Visual Manager und SIS Project Manager mit der Identifizierung von SIS-Möglichkeiten und Wartungs- und Renovierungsanforderungen. • Führen Sie erstklassiges Setup und Dekoration von Brand-gesponserten Ereignissen, mono- und multi-brand-verwandt, um die visuelle Wirkung zu maximieren. • Partner mit Management bei der Planung und Durchführung von funktionellen Schulungen, Führungsentwicklung, Produkt- und Vertriebsausbildung und anderen vereinbarten Ausbildungsstrategien. Schulungs- und Entwicklungskompetenzen • Erleichterung von Schulungen für Store Manager und Mitarbeiter im Fokus der aktuellen visuellen Merchandising Standards, Produktplatzierung und Customer Experience Best Practices. • Bereitstellung umfassender Kommunikations- und Schulungsprogramme für Läden • Partner mit Management bei der Planung und Durchführung von Funktions-, Führungs-, Produkt- und Vertriebstrainingsprogrammen. • Bereitstellung von laufenden Coaching, um Teams zu speichern, Fähigkeiten Lücken zu identifizieren und Entwicklungsinitiativen zu empfehlen. • Foster starke Beziehungen zu Store-Teams zur Unterstützung der Annahme von visuellen und Trainingsstandards. Zusätzliche Aufgaben • Überwachen Sie regionale Geschäftstrends, Konkurrententrends durch Lesen und Verständnis von Geschäftsberichten und identifizieren Sie mögliche Möglichkeiten zur Unterstützung des Umsatzwachstums. • Führen Sie andere Aufgaben wie von der Verwaltung zugewiesen. Anforderungen Bildung und Erfahrung Anforderungen • High School Diploma oder GED erforderlich; College-Abschluss bevorzugt. • 2-3 Jahre Erfahrung im Einzelhandel mit visuellen Waren, vorzugsweise in Spezialwaren, Schmuck oder Uhren. • Starke verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. • Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel und PowerPoint. • gültige Führerschein erforderlich. • Bewährte Fähigkeit, verschiedene Teams in einem schnellen Einzelhandelsumfeld zu trainieren und zu trainieren. • Starkes Auge für Design, Layout und Markengeschichte durch Produktpräsentation. • Fähigkeit, mehrere Aufgaben zu priorisieren und in einer dynamischen, schnellen Umgebung zu leben. • Der Arbeitsplan wird von Montag bis Freitag variieren und kann ein gelegentliches Wochenende beinhalten. • Inlands- und Auslandsvermögen bis zu 80-85% der Zeit (mindestens 4 Tage pro Woche). Physikalische Anforderungen: Dies ist in erster Linie aktive Position, die der Visual Merchandiser & Trainer benötigt, um die verschiedenen Standorte zu bewegen, während kontinuierlich Kletterleitern, Biegen, Hopfen, Heben, Erreichen, Bewegen und Tragen bis zu 40 lbs. Es gibt häufige Reisen zu mehreren Einzelhandelsstandorten innerhalb des zugewiesenen Territoriums. Die Position erfordert die Fähigkeit, Kraftfahrzeuge, Computer und Tablets zu bedienen, klar zu kommunizieren und physisch mit visuellen Merchandising-Setups zu interagieren. Fingerabschreckung ist notwendig. Freizeitabend oder Wochenende arbeiten, um Lageröffnungen, saisonale Übergänge oder besondere Veranstaltungen zu unterstützen. Zusätzliche Qualifikationsanforderungen: • Starke Organisations-, Projektmanagement- und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten. • Vertrauenskommunikator und Moderator. • Selbst motiviert, proaktiv und schnell lernend. • Fähigkeit, unabhängig und als Teil eines Teams zu arbeiten. • Fähigkeit zu bleiben verlobt und reagieren, wenn Sie remote arbeiten. • Flexibilität für längere Arbeitszeiten bei Bedarf. • Bereitschaft, Feedback zu akzeptieren und kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Diese Beschreibung beschreibt die grundlegenden Aufgaben und Anforderungen für die Rolle. Dies ist keine umfassende Auflistung aller Aufgaben des Visual Merchandiser & Trainer. Pflichten, Pflichten und Aktivitäten können sich jederzeit mit oder ohne Ankündigung entwickeln oder ändern. Vergütung & Leistungen Der jährliche Grundgehalt für diese Position beträgt $70.000–$77.000. Die tatsächliche Entschädigung wird anhand von Faktoren wie Erfahrung und Fähigkeiten bestimmt. Diese Position ist auch für einen jährlichen Bonus geeignet. Die Swatch Group ist ein Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit, der Vielfalt fördert und sich der ökologischen Nachhaltigkeit verpflichtet. Hervorragende Kranken-, Zahn- und Sehversicherung (Arbeitnehmer und abhängige Personen sind berechtigt 1. des Monats nach 30 Tagen; großzügiger Arbeitgeberbeitrag) Sofortige Teilnahme an der 401(k) und 100 % vested Arbeitgeber Match nach einem Jahr (maximal 4% Arbeitgeber Match mit 5% Arbeitnehmerbeitrag) Unternehmen bezahlte Lebensversicherung und langfristige Behinderung 18 Tage PTO pro Jahr Spezial-Bucket der Krankenzeit pro Jahr verlängerte bezahlte Zeit für medizinische, Eltern- und Militärurlaub Urlaub zahlen Freiwillige FSA, STD, Unfall-/ Krankenhaus-Indemnity-Versicherung Mitarbeiterproduktrabatt Für weitere Informationen siehe http://transparency-in-coverage.uhc.com/ #SGUSC Job Location New York Street 89 Bewerben Sie sich für diesen Job Teilen Sie dieses Stellenangebot
descriptionByLocale.fr: Marchandiser et formateur visuel - Nord-Est - Swatch Group Marchandiser et formateur visuel - Nord-Est La Compagnie Hamilton est un nom emblématique de l'horlogerie de précision depuis sa fondation à Lancaster en Pennsylvanie en 1892. Ses montres ont synchronisé les premiers chemins de fer et fourni les poignets de soldats, d'aviateurs et d'étoiles d'Hollywood, faisant plus de 500 apparitions sur grand écran. Hamilton a été à la pointe des innovations dans le design, la technologie et l'artisanat en lançant la première montre électrique du monde en 1957 et la montre numérique LED en 1970. Membre du Swatch Group, leader mondial de la fabrication et de la distribution horlogères, Hamilton allie son esprit américain à une véritable précision suisse. Description du poste En tant que marchand et formateur visuel avec Hamilton, aux États-Unis, le poste sera chargé de soutenir les ventes d'horlogerie dans notre compte de détail et de gros par le biais du merchandising visuel et de la formation. Ce rôle supervisera la représentation visuelle de notre marque et de nos produits de Hamilton dans toutes les boutiques (de détail et de gros) de la région du Territoire du Nord-Est. Visual Merchandiser & Trainer sera également responsable du maintien des initiatives de formation qui permettront d'accroître la connaissance de la marque et des produits de Hamilton. Les tâches comprennent la planification, l'organisation, la coordination, la formation et la mise en œuvre de toutes les mesures de marchandisation visuelle qui ont été élaborées par marque. Cette position est une position sur le terrain. Profil Responsabilités visuelles en matière de marchandisation • Mettre en oeuvre et maintenir des normes visuelles en matière de marchandisation dans les magasins de détail et de gros, en veillant au respect des lignes directrices de l'entreprise et des normes de marque. • Effectuer régulièrement des visites de magasin pour évaluer l'exécution visuelle, en fournissant des ajustements et des recommandations sur place. • Contribuer à la réalisation des objectifs de volume des ventes en assurant une présentation et un maintien efficaces de toutes les catégories de produits, en veillant à ce que tous les magasins soient installés correctement pendant les promotions et les activités régulières. • Préparer et distribuer du matériel de communication relatif aux affichages visuels conformément aux lignes directrices de la marque. • Gérer les relations avec les fournisseurs en plaçant et en suivant les commandes visuelles afin d'assurer la mise en œuvre en temps voulu et l'envoi centralisé de matériel visuel à l'emplacement commercial. • Coordonner la distribution interne des matériaux visuels aux magasins, en assurant la conformité et la visibilité. • Collaborez avec les points de vente, les équipes régionales et la direction de la marque pour planifier et exécuter des ensembles de sol, des vitrines, des transitions saisonnières et des configurations promotionnelles. • Identifier les opportunités de merchandising visuel à l'intérieur et à l'extérieur des magasins, développer des idées de décoration de fenêtre innovantes. • Créer et maintenir une photothèque documentant les conditions de boutique avant et après les visites. • Fournir des rapports de récapitulation résumant les résultats des visites et les recommandations d'amélioration. • Aider le gestionnaire visuel et le gestionnaire de projet SIS à identifier les possibilités de SIS et les besoins de maintenance/rénovation. • Diriger la configuration et la décoration de première classe d'événements sponsorisés par la marque, liés à la mono- et multi-marque, pour maximiser l'impact visuel. • S'associer à la direction pour planifier et exécuter la formation fonctionnelle, le développement du leadership, la formation aux produits et aux ventes et d'autres stratégies de formation convenues. Responsabilités en matière de formation et de perfectionnement • Faciliter les séances de formation pour les gestionnaires de magasins et les associés, axées sur les normes actuelles de merchandising visuel, le placement de produits et les meilleures pratiques en matière d'expérience client. • Offrir aux magasins des programmes complets de communication et de formation • S'associer à la direction pour planifier et exécuter des programmes de formation fonctionnelle, de leadership, de produits et de vente. • Fournir un encadrement continu aux équipes, cerner les lacunes en matière de compétences et recommander des initiatives de développement. • Favoriser des relations solides avec les équipes de magasin pour favoriser l'adoption de normes visuelles et de formation. Responsabilités additionnelles • Surveiller les tendances des entreprises régionales, les tendances des concurrents en lisant et en comprenant les rapports d'affaires et identifier les possibilités potentielles de soutenir la croissance des ventes. • S'acquitter d'autres tâches assignées par la direction. Exigences Exigences en matière d'éducation et d'expérience • Diplôme d'études secondaires ou DEG requis; diplôme collégial préféré. • 2-3 ans d'expérience de merchandising visuel au détail, de préférence dans les produits spécialisés, les bijoux ou les montres. • Fortes compétences en communication verbale et écrite. • Compétence en Microsoft Word, Excel et PowerPoint. • Permis de conduire valide requis. • Capacité éprouvée d'entraîner et de former diverses équipes dans un environnement de vente rapide. • Un œil fort pour la conception, la mise en page et la narration de la marque grâce à la présentation du produit. • Capacité de prioriser les responsabilités multiples et de prospérer dans un environnement dynamique et rapide. • L'horaire de travail varie du lundi au vendredi et peut comprendre une fin de semaine occasionnelle. • Capacité d'atteindre 80 à 85 % du temps (minimum 4 jours par semaine de travail). Exigences physiques: Il s'agit d'une position principalement active qui exige du Visual Merchandiser & Trainer qu'il se déplace autour des différents emplacements tout en grimpant en permanence les échelles, en flexion, en s'inclinant, en soulevant, en atteignant, en se déplaçant et en transportant jusqu'à 40 lbs. Il y a des voyages fréquents vers plusieurs points de vente au détail sur le territoire assigné. La position nécessite la capacité d'utiliser des véhicules à moteur, des ordinateurs et des tablettes, de communiquer clairement et de s'engager physiquement dans des configurations de merchandising visuel. La dextérité du doigt est nécessaire. Travail occasionnel le soir ou la fin de semaine pour soutenir les ouvertures de magasins, les transitions saisonnières ou les événements spéciaux. Exigences supplémentaires en matière de compétences : • Compétences solides en matière d'organisation, de gestion de projet et de résolution de problèmes. • Communicateur et présentateur confiants. • Automotivé, proactif et un apprenant rapide. • Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante et en équipe. • Capacité de rester engagé et réactif lorsque vous travaillez à distance. • Flexibilité au travail des heures prolongées au besoin. • Volonté d'accepter les retours et d'améliorer continuellement. Cette description décrit les responsabilités et les exigences de base du rôle. Il ne s'agit pas d'une liste exhaustive de toutes les fonctions du Visual Merchandiser & Trainer. Les fonctions, responsabilités et activités peuvent évoluer ou changer à tout moment, avec ou sans préavis. Rémunération et avantages sociaux L'échelle salariale de base annuelle pour ce poste est de 70 000 $ à 77 000 $. La rémunération réelle sera déterminée en fonction de facteurs tels que l'expérience et les compétences. Ce poste est également admissible à une prime annuelle. Le Swatch Group est un employeur à chances égales qui favorise la diversité et qui est engagé dans la durabilité environnementale. Excellente assurance santé, soins dentaires et vision (les employés et les personnes à charge sont admissibles 1er du mois suivant 30 jours; généreuse contribution de l'employeur) Participation immédiate à la correspondance 401k) et 100 % de l'employeur acquis après un an (maximum 4 % de l'employeur correspond à la contribution de 5 % de l'employé) Assurance-vie payée par l'entreprise et invalidité de longue durée 18 jours de PTO par année Seau spécial de temps de maladie par année prolongation du temps payé pour les congés médicaux, parentaux et militaires Indemnité de vacances Volontaire FSA, STD, Accident/Hospital Indemnity assurance Réduction du produit de l'employé Pour plus d'information, veuillez consulter https://transparency-in-coverage.uhc.com/ #SGUSC Lieu de travail East 42nd Street 89 10017 New York NY (New York) United States Adresse de la société The Swatch Group (U.S.) Inc. 800 Waterford Way Suite 1000 Miami, FL 33126 Postuler à cette offre Partager cette offre d'emploi

descriptionByLocale.en:
Senior SAP FICO Business Analyst - Swatch Group

Senior SAP FICO Business Analyst
The company
The Swatch Group Ltd. in Biel (Switzerland) is the world’s largest manufacturer of finished watches. The Swatch Group is synonymous for durable, emotional consumer products of high quality. With its own worldwide network of distribution organizations, the Group is active in the manufacture of finished watches, movements and components (e.g. ETA). It produces practically all the components necessary to its watch companies.
Job description
You will join a large and dynamic SAP Competence Center and play a key role in designing and implementing solutions that support complex business requirements across global operations.
Working closely with internal SAP teams, IT departments, business stakeholders and external partners, you will contribute to major transformation initiatives and ensure the continuous improvement of SAP processes.
Your main responsibilities include:
• Gather, analyze and challenge business requirements to ensure alignment with global processes.
• Propose robust and scalable SAP solutions and perform system configuration.
• Prepare detailed functional specifications and collaborate closely with SAP developers.
• Train key users and support change management activities.
• Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and Non‑Regression Testing (NRT).
• Act as module lead on projects and contribute to cross‑functional initiatives.
• Maintain up‑to‑date documentation on processes, configurations and system design.
• Analyze and resolve complex incidents and provide expert-level operational support.
• Manage enhancements and continuous improvement activities within your SAP domain.
• Profile
• The ideal candidate brings:
• A strong track record as a Senior SAP expert, delivering high‑impact solutions in global environments.
• Deep understanding of business processes and SAP integration, especially across FI/CO and EWM.
• The ability to translate complex business needs into scalable, future‑proof SAP configurations.
• Confidence acting as a functional lead, driving workshops and influencing key decisions.
• Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate with business teams, IT, developers, and external partners.
• Strong analytical and problem‑solving abilities, with autonomy in handling complex issues.
• A proactive, customer‑focused mindset and commitment to continuous improvement.
• The ability to work effectively under pressure and manage priorities in a dynamic environment.
• Experience mentoring or coaching junior team members.
• Professional requirements
• Required skills and experience:
• 7+ years of SAP customizing experience in major implementation or transformation projects.
• Strong understanding of ABAP concepts and integration technologies (EDI, API, RFC).
• Solid knowledge of business processes and SAP integration, especially FI/CO and EWM.
• Hands‑on experience with SAP S/4HANA and awareness of recent SAP innovations.
• Effective communication and collaboration skills in an international environment.
• Strong organizational abilities and capacity to manage multiple priorities.
• Customer‑focused mindset with a proactive approach to continuous improvement.
• Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Informatics, or equivalent; SAP FI/CO certification is an asset.

• Fluency in English

Senior SAP Developer - Swatch Group

Senior SAP Developer
The company
The Swatch Group Ltd. in Biel (Switzerland) is the world’s largest manufacturer of finished watches. The Swatch Group is synonymous for durable, emotional consumer products of high quality. With its own worldwide network of distribution organizations, the Group is active in the manufacture of finished watches, movements and components (e.g. ETA). It produces practically all the components necessary to its watch companies.
Job description
You will join a large and dynamic SAP Competence Center and play a key role in designing, developing and implementing solutions that support complex business requirements across global operations.
Working closely with SAP Business Analysts, functional teams and technical stakeholders, you will analyze requirements, build robust SAP developments, contribute to project activities and ensure the long‑term reliability and performance of SAP applications.
Your main responsibilities include:
• Analyzing business requirements together with SAP Business Analysts and translating them into technical SAP solutions.
• Designing, developing, documenting and maintaining SAP programs and enhancements.
• Evaluating change requests, proposing technical designs and implementing scalable solutions.
• Supporting Fit/Gap analysis, data migration activities and go‑live phases within SAP projects.
• Creating and maintaining functional and technical specifications, including test cases.
• Collaborating closely with Business Analysts and cross‑functional teams to ensure alignment between functional needs and technical delivery.
• Ensuring adherence to SAP development best practices, performance standards and code quality guidelines.
• Profile
• The ideal candidate brings:
• Extensive experience as an SAP Developer with strong expertise in ABAP and modern SAP development frameworks.
• Deep understanding of SAP modules such as FI, CO, MM, SD, QM and experience with SAP Solution Manager.
• Strong ability to translate functional requirements into robust, scalable and maintainable technical solutions.
• Hands‑on experience with S/4HANA development, CDS views, OData services and RESTful programming.
• Experience building Fiori applications end‑to‑end and applying best practices for modern SAP UX.
• Solid knowledge of integration technologies including IDocs, ALE, RFC and API‑based communication.
• A structured, analytical and solution‑oriented mindset with strong problem‑solving abilities.
• The ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within technical and functional teams.
• A passion for development, continuous learning and delivering high‑quality solutions in an international environment.
• Professional requirements
• Required skills and experience:
• 10+ years of experience in SAP ABAP development across multiple modules (FI, CO, MM, SD, QM).
• Strong experience with SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA.
• In‑depth knowledge of ABAP, Adobe Forms, SmartForms, SAPScripts and performance‑optimized coding.
• Expertise in IDocs, ALE, SQL and JavaScript.
• Strong experience with CDS views, OData services and SAP RESTful ABAP programming.
• Ability to build Fiori applications from end to end.
• Experience with backend service creation and exposure to external applications.
• Familiarity with ATC, code quality standards and Fiori‑based modernization of legacy developments.
• Experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) is an advantage (APIs, Cloud Events, BAS, Fiori Elements, Build).
• Knowledge of extensibility best practices in S/4HANA Cloud and use of Custom Business Objects.
• Experience with low‑code platforms (Neptune, Mendix) and basic Java knowledge.
• Strong analytical skills, problem‑solving abilities and a customer‑oriented mindset.
• University degree in Information Technology, Information Management or equivalent.
• Languages
• Fluency in English; additional languages are a plus.

descriptionByLocale.en:
IT Project Manager - Swatch Group

IT Project Manager
The company
The Swatch Group Ltd. in Biel (Switzerland) is the world’s largest manufacturer of finished watches. The Swatch Group is synonymous for durable, emotional consumer products of high quality. With its own worldwide network of distribution organizations, the Group is active in the manufacture of finished watches, movements and components (e.g. ETA). It produces practically all the components necessary to its watch companies.
Job description
You will join a large and collaborative IT organization and play a key role in managing strategic projects across the American subsidiaries of the Group.
Working closely with business stakeholders, IT teams, enterprise architects and external partners, you will ensure the successful delivery of approved projects, from initial demand through handover to operations, while contributing to program management and supporting change initiatives.
Your main responsibilities include:
• Managing approved IT projects according to agreed budgets, timelines and scope.
• Ensuring effective project execution from demand intake to operational handover, following the Group’s project management methodology.
• Preparing and maintaining project documentation, investment requests and decision materials.
• Coordinating with enterprise architects to ensure proper architectural alignment during conceptual phases.
• Collaborating with external partners and ensuring proper follow‑up on deliverables.
• Communicating regularly with stakeholders, including business teams, management, PMO and related project teams.
• Supporting conflict resolution, resource coordination and scope management.
• Contributing to program management activities and facilitating change management across impacted teams.
• Profile
• The ideal candidate brings:
• Strong experience managing IT projects in a multinational environment.
• The ability to lead projects end‑to‑end, ensuring alignment with business priorities and IT strategy.
• Solid understanding of business processes, logistics flows and project governance.
• The capacity to coordinate diverse stakeholders and maintain clear, structured communication.
• A proactive, organized and solution‑oriented mindset.
• The ability to manage risks, dependencies and resources in a dynamic environment.
• A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively with technical teams, architects and external partners.
• Strong analytical abilities and the capacity to evaluate business demands and scope potential projects.
• Professional requirements
• Required skills and experience:
• 10+ years of experience in IT project management.
• Experience working in a large multinational corporation with international exposure.
• Expertise in IT project management, including planning, execution and stakeholder coordination.
• Strong understanding of business management and logistics processes.
• Good knowledge of infrastructure technologies, including cloud, networking and data center environments.
• Experience with SAP S/4HANA or modules such as SD/MM or FI/CO is an asset.
• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
• Ability to model information flows and support change management activities.
• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or equivalent.
• Project management certifications (PMP, Scrum Master, etc.) are considered an asset.
• Languages
• Fluency in English; additional languages are a plus.

Data Integration Engineer - Swatch Group

Data Integration Engineer
The company
The Swatch Group Ltd. in Biel (Switzerland) is the world’s largest manufacturer of finished watches. The Swatch Group is synonymous for durable, emotional consumer products of high quality. With its own worldwide network of distribution organizations, the Group is active in the manufacture of finished watches, movements and components (e.g. ETA). It produces practically all the components necessary to its watch companies.
Job description
You will join the Integration Competence Center (INTCC) within the Group IT Applications Division and contribute to the design, development and support of data integration and distribution solutions for the American markets.
Working closely with IT teams, architects, business stakeholders and external partners, you will help extend and operate the Group’s Single Source of Truth (SSOT) data hub, strengthen data integration capabilities and ensure the reliability of the integration landscape.
Your main responsibilities include:
• Designing, developing and enhancing data integration and distribution solutions across brands and countries.
• Implementing and extending the SSOT data hub using MS SQL, stored procedures and WebMethods components.
• Designing robust data integration architectures and data models to support business and IT needs.
• Supporting governance activities related to master data, interfaces and integration processes.
• Providing operational support for the integration landscape, including infrastructure, applications and middleware.
• Collaborating with developers, architects and cross‑functional teams to ensure high‑quality integration flows.
• Maintaining documentation related to processes, system setup, data models and integration components.
• Profile
• The ideal candidate brings:
• Strong experience in data integration, data modeling and SQL‑based development.
• The ability to design and implement integration solutions across multiple systems and markets.
• Hands‑on experience with MS SQL, stored procedures, SSIS/ETL tools and related plugins.
• Familiarity with EAI/ESB technologies, ideally Software AG WebMethods or similar stacks.
• Experience with APIs, XML, SOAP and REST‑based integrations.
• Exposure to SAP integration technologies such as IDocs, RFCs or ABAP debugging.
• A structured, analytical and solution‑oriented mindset.
• The ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a technical team.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to interact with diverse stakeholders.
• Professional requirements
• Required skills and experience:
• +10 years of IT experience, including at least 2 years in designing and developing data integration or MDM solutions.
• At least 5 years of experience in data integration, data modeling and SQL‑based development.
• Expertise with MS SQL, stored procedures and relational database design.
• Strong experience with SSIS/ETL tools and plugins such as Theobald for SAP‑related integrations.
• Experience with WebMethods or other EAI/ESB platforms.
• Experience in Java/JEE development and object‑oriented programming.
• Experience developing web applications (AngularJS, WebMethods CAF UI or similar).
• Strong knowledge of XML, SOAP, REST and API‑based integrations.
• Experience with SAP integration technologies (IDoc, ALE, RFC, ABAP debugging) is an advantage.
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Technology or equivalent.
• Starting base salary range between 110k-140k/year (plus a yearly bonus potential)

Associé de Ventes / Sales Associate (Montreal Eaton Centre)
The company
Depuis 1853, Tissot est au cœur de l’horlogerie suisse. Notre engagement envers l’artisanat et la qualité est égalé seulement par notre passion pour la performance et la précision. Nos produits pionniers, comme le célèbre Tissot T-Touch, ont marqué l’histoire. Le Tissot T-Touch Connect Solar, alimenté par l’énergie solaire et doté de technologies connectées respectueuses de la vie privée, confirme notre réputation d’innovateurs par tradition.
Job description
• En tant qu’Associé de Ventes Tissot, vous relèverez du Responsable de Magasin et serez responsable de l’atteinte des objectifs de vente.
• Rémunération compétitive + commission mensuelle.
• Avantages :
• Avantages de santé, y compris la couverture dentaire et visuelle
• Cotisations REER avec contrepartie de l’entreprise
• Rabais d’entreprise
• Assurance vie
• Les responsabilités sont les suivantes:
Service à la clientèle et génération de ventes: Fournir un service à la clientèle exceptionnel en aidant les clients et en résolvant les problèmes avec une attitude positive. Atteindre et dépasser les objectifs de vente grâce à une excellente connaissance des produits.
• Opérations: Soutenir les opérations quotidiennes, y compris le traitement des ventes et des retours, la gestion des stocks et le respect des politiques et procédures opérationnelles.
• Marchandisage visuel: Aider à maintenir les normes visuelles du magasin en suivant les directives de marchandisage visuel. Il participe au maintien de la propreté et de l'organisation du magasin.
• Conformité: Respecter les normes de sécurité sur le lieu de travail.
• Conditions de travail:
Le travail est effectué avec un effort physique modéré et nécessite de marcher et de se tenir debout pendant la majeure partie de chaque période de travail. Bien que ce poste présente un faible risque de blessure, il nécessite de soulever, pousser, tirer et tenir (jusqu'à 35 livres et plus avec un soutien approprié) des boîtes et des accessoires de magasin, ainsi que de se concentrer pour remplir des documents, gérer la trésorerie ou utiliser le point de vente.
Statut d’Emploi:
Temps Partiel: En moyenne 20 heures par semaine. Doit maintenir une disponibilité ouverte pour répondre aux besoins de l’entreprise et peut être amené à travailler plus de 20 heures par semaine, y compris certains jours fériés et périodes de pointe.
Profile
• Disponibilité pour travailler dans les équipes d'ouverture et de fermeture ; horaires flexibles, y compris les week-ends et les jours fériés.
• Solides compétences en matière de communication (verbale et écrite), y compris de solides compétences en matière d'établissement de relations.
• Le candidat doit faire preuve d'initiative et être capable de travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.
• Capacité à communiquer de manière claire, concise et compréhensible.
• Orienté vers les résultats et doté d'un haut niveau d'énergie et d'enthousiasme.
• Passion pour la vente et le travail dans un environnement en évolution rapide.
• Professional requirements
• Au moins 2 an d’expérience en vente au détail, de préférence dans la mode et/ou les accessoires.
• Expérience avec les systèmes de point de vente (POS).

## Mansioni
- Raggiungere gli obiettivi attraverso l'esecuzione del nostro programma di produttività, la formazione dei membri del team e un servizio clienti eccezionale.
- Garantire un'esperienza in negozio coerente e rispettabile per i nostri clienti.
- Essere in grado di pensare in modo strategico ed efficiente durante la gestione del negozio secondo gli standard aziendali.
- Possedere la capacità di stabilire priorità, pianificare, delegare e adattarsi alle esigenze aziendali in vari momenti.
- Massimizzare le tecniche di gestione dell'inventario, del controllo del contante e della prevenzione delle perdite.
- Garantire un adeguato organico del negozio attraverso il reclutamento e la fidelizzazione del personale.
- Creare e promuovere un ambiente nutriente per il team per prosperare e avere successo.
- Sviluppare e guidare un ampio team di dipendenti.

## Requisiti
- 3-5 anni di esperienza nella gestione di negozi al dettaglio richiesti per tutti i candidati, preferibilmente nel settore della vendita al dettaglio specializzata
- Passione per la diffusione della cultura del marchio SWATCH
- Eccellenti capacità organizzative, di comunicazione e informatiche.
- Capacità di guidare e mantenere un negozio efficiente e coeso.
- Orientamento al lavoro di squadra

## Cosa offriamo
- Il Swatch Group è un datore di lavoro che offre pari opportunità, promuove la diversità ed è impegnato nella sostenibilità ambientale e siamo lieti di offrire un pacchetto di benefici competitivo che include:
- Ottima assicurazione sanitaria, dentistica e oftalmica (idoneità dal primo giorno del mese successivo a 30 giorni; generoso contributo del datore di lavoro)
- Partecipazione immediata al 401(k) e corrispondenza del datore di lavoro al 100% dopo un anno
- Assicurazione sulla vita e assicurazione per l'invalidità a lungo termine pagate dall'azienda
- 18 giorni di ferie retribuite all'anno, 23 giorni di ferie retribuite dopo 5 anni
- 7 giorni all'anno di congedo retribuito esteso per motivi medici, parentali e militari
- Retribuzione festiva
- Conto di spesa flessibile volontario, assicurazione per l'invalidità a breve termine, assicurazione per incidenti/indennità ospedaliera
- Sconto sui prodotti per i dipendenti
- Potenziale di trasferimento interno e di crescita
- Bonus di segnalazione di dipendenti di 500 $
- Per ulteriori informazioni, consultare: https://transparency-in-coverage.uhc.com/
- Fascia salariale: da 75.000 a 85.000 dollari
